help.title: How to Use 24GO
help.subtitle: Step-by-step guide to automated lead generation
help.step1.title: Register & Subscribe
help.step1.desc: Create your account and choose a plan to get started.
help.step1.details:
Go to Billing to select a plan that fits your needs.
• Starter ($75/mo): 1,500 posts, 1M tokens, 5 accounts
• Pro ($199/mo): 7,500 posts, 5M tokens, 20 accounts
• Enterprise ($499/mo): Unlimited everything
Start with a 14-day free trial — no credit card required.
help.step2.title: Connect Telegram Account
help.step2.desc: Link your Telegram account to start intercepting DMs and monitoring groups.
help.step2.details:
Go to Accounts → click "+ Add Account" → enter your phone number → enter the code from Telegram → if 2FA is enabled, enter your cloud password.
Your account will be warmed up automatically (2-5 days) before entering production.
help.step3.title: Discover Target Groups
help.step3.desc: Find Telegram groups and channels where your audience hangs out.
help.step3.details:
Go to Targets → enter your GEO (city/country) and niche (e.g. real_estate, tourism) → click Scan.
The system will find relevant public groups and channels.
Alternatively, go to Groups → Auto-Discover for more options.
help.step4.title: Set Up Scoring Rules
help.step4.desc: Customize how leads are classified into HOT / WARM / COLD / SPAM.
help.step4.details:
Go to Scoring → create rules with keywords for each intent level.
Rules are evaluated by priority (highest first).
If no rules match, the built-in keyword heuristic is used as fallback.
You can also adjust AI classification in Settings → AI & Classification.
help.step5.title: Start Listener
help.step5.desc: Begin intercepting incoming messages as leads automatically.
help.step5.details:
Go to Accounts → find a connected account → click "Listen".
The listener monitors DMs and groups 24/7, capturing messages and classifying them as leads.
Make sure the account has passed warmup before starting.
help.step6.title: Create Posting Campaign
help.step6.desc: Automatically post to target groups on a schedule.
help.step6.details:
Go to Campaigns → "New Campaign" → write your post text (supports spintax: {hello|hi|hey}).
Set schedule, target GEOs, and niches.
The system posts automatically and captures leads from comments and replies.
help.step7.title: Monitor Leads
help.step7.desc: View, filter, and convert leads from the Kanban pipeline.
help.step7.details:
Go to Leads to see all captured leads. Use the Kanban view to drag leads between stages.
Filter by intent (HOT/WARM/COLD), source (DM/Comments), or status.
Click any lead to see the full conversation history and dialog link.
Export leads to CSV anytime.
help.step8.title: Configure Auto-Reply
help.step8.desc: Automatically respond to leads with strong buying intent.
help.step8.details:
Go to Settings → Auto-Reply tab.
Enable auto-reply and set the minimum intent level (HOT or WARM).
Write your reply message and set a delay to look more natural.
Rate limiting prevents spam (max replies per hour).
help.step9.title: Connect Webhooks
help.step9.desc: Push leads to n8n or other automation tools via webhooks.
help.step9.details:
Go to Settings → Webhooks tab.
Enter your n8n webhook URL and optional HMAC secret.
Click "Test Connection" to verify.
Qualified leads will be sent to your webhook in real-time.
help.tip1: Start with 2-3 groups in your niche before scaling up. Quality > quantity.
help.tip2: Customize AI keywords in Settings to improve classification accuracy for your industry.
help.tip3: Use spintax in campaigns ({option1|option2}) to avoid duplicate content detection.
help.tip4: Check the Analytics page weekly to track conversion rates and optimize your approach.
help.tip5: The warmup period is mandatory — don't rush it. Accounts that skip warmup get banned faster.
help.faqTrial.q: How does the free trial work?
help.faqTrial.a: You get 14 days with 100 posts and 100k AI tokens. No credit card required. After 14 days, you need to upgrade to a paid plan to continue.
help.faqAccounts.q: How many Telegram accounts can I connect?
help.faqAccounts.a: Depends on your plan: Starter — 5 accounts, Pro — 20 accounts, Enterprise — unlimited. Each account can independently monitor groups and capture leads.
help.faqWarmup.q: What is account warmup and why is it needed?
help.faqWarmup.a: Warmup gradually builds your account's reputation over 2-5 days. The system reads channels, reacts to posts, and slowly increases activity. This prevents Telegram from banning new accounts that immediately start posting.
help.faqLeads.a: The system monitors DMs to your connected accounts and messages in groups you've added. Each message is analyzed by AI for buying intent. Qualified leads appear in your dashboard with full conversation history.
help.faqAI.q: Can I customize how the AI classifies leads?
help.faqAI.a: Yes! Go to Settings → AI & Classification. You can set custom keywords for HOT/WARM/SPAM, adjust confidence thresholds, and even switch between AI providers (OpenRouter, DeepSeek, OpenAI).
help.faqBilling.a: Stripe charges you monthly at the start of each billing period. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel anytime from the Billing page.
help.faqTelegram.q: Is it safe to connect my Telegram account?
help.faqTelegram.a: Your session data is encrypted at rest. The system only reads messages — it never sends messages from your personal account without explicit campaign setup. You can disconnect any account at any time.
help.faqLimits.q: What happens when I reach my plan limits?
help.faqLimits.a: You'll see a warning when approaching limits. Once reached, new posts and AI classifications stop until the next billing period or until you upgrade. Existing leads are preserved.
